evidence.V6: Disciplined: kit gold rim in two values, one hue field (teal) with darker inset edge, cream emblem; colourways swap only the field hue
evidence.V8: One white vertex-colour material, kit gold/cream palette, ~0.045 stud chamfers and smooth shading match the PASS badge anchor
